subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue first-party CarPlay support in the official iOS app, and if so which Apple category/entitlement and driving-safe capability set should it target?
rationale: The request is aligned with iOS companion-app direction, but Apple entitlement eligibility, App Store signing, and in-vehicle assistant safety are product decisions automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve design-gated CarPlay
options.body: Choose the Apple category, entitlement request path, allowed command/session behavior, and proof requirements before opening implementation work.

options.title: Fold into mobile RFC
options.body: Move the idea into the mobile app RFC process if maintainers want CarPlay evaluated with broader mobile design direction before accepting a platform-specific issue.

options.title: Decline first-party CarPlay for now
options.body: Close or freeze the direction until Apple eligibility or maintainer ownership is clearer, leaving normal iOS Talk as the supported mobile voice path.

recommendation.title: Approve design-gated CarPlay
recommendation.body: Choose the Apple category, entitlement request path, allowed command/session behavior, and proof requirements before opening implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: The live discussion tagged this handle for iOS app product input, and their merged iOS Talk work is the closest existing implementation surface.
